description:
Outcome: Visitors see waiting/helped first names and anonymous references, from BRIEF.md and owner privacy constraint.
Scope: Dedicated accessible board route; read-only API projection excluding repair details; initial fetch, ordering, shared state/render interface; no-store data; expiry timer from server day expiry; offline midnight clearing and rejection of expired initial/manual responses. Excludes: periodic polling and reconnection scheduler (V2).
Acceptance: Page load shows current waiting/helped queue, no repair details; duplicates distinguishable; completed entries hidden; clear empty state; all displayed data removed at day expiry even offline.
Behaviour: Safe text rendering, readable accessible display, loading/error/empty/expired-day states.
Verification: Projection and component tests, fake-timer expiry, cache/back-navigation tests. Prerequisites: Q2 transitions. Assumptions: expiry timer enforces privacy, not polling; ten-second updates belong to V2.
Setup label: V1. Split from auto-refresh at owner request.
title: Public board page
